class.name: OcgGpCirc
class.brief_description: Describes a circle in 3D space. A circle is defined by its radius and positioned in space with a coordinate system (a gp_Ax2 object) as follows: - the origin of the coordinate system is the center of the circle, and - the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of the coordinate system define the plane of the circle. This positioning coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" of the circle. Its "main Direction" gives the normal vector to the plane of the circle. The "main Axis" of the coordinate system is referred to as the "Axis" of the circle. Note: when a gp_Circ circle is converted into a Geom_Circle circle, some implicit properties of the circle are used explicitly: - the "main Direction" of the local coordinate system gives an implicit orientation to the circle (and defines its trigonometric sense), - this orientation corresponds to the direction in which parameter values increase, - the starting point for parameterization is that of the "X Axis" of the local coordinate system (i.e. the "X Axis" of the circle). See Also gce_MakeCirc which provides functions for more complex circle constructions Geom_Circle which provides additional functions for constructing circles and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of circles

method.name: gp_Circ
method.description: Creates an indefinite circle.

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Changes the main axis of the circle. It is the axis perpendicular to the plane of the circle. Raises ConstructionError if the direction of theA1 is parallel to the "XAxis" of the circle.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the "Location" point (center) of the circle.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Changes the position of the circle.

method.name: SetRadius
method.description: Modifies the radius of this circle. Warning. This class does not prevent the creation of a circle where theRadius is null. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if theRadius is negative.

method.name: Area
method.description: Computes the area of the circle.

method.name: Axis
method.description: Returns the main axis of the circle. It is the axis perpendicular to the plane of the circle, passing through the "Location" point (center) of the circle.

method.name: Length
method.description: Computes the circumference of the circle.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the center of the circle. It is the "Location" point of the local coordinate system of the circle

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the position of the circle. It is the local coordinate system of the circle.

method.name: Radius
method.description: Returns the radius of this circle.

method.name: XAxis
method.description: Returns the "XAxis" of the circle. This axis is perpendicular to the axis of the conic. This axis and the "Yaxis" define the plane of the conic.

method.name: YAxis
method.description: Returns the "YAxis" of the circle. This axis and the "Xaxis" define the plane of the conic. The "YAxis" is perpendicular to the "Xaxis".

method.name: Distance
method.description: Computes the minimum of distance between the point theP and any point on the circumference of the circle.

method.name: SquareDistance
method.description: Computes the square distance between <me> and the point theP.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a circle with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a circle with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a circle with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the of the symmetry : (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a circle. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a circle. theS is the scaling value. Warnings : If theS is negative the radius stay positive but the "XAxis" and the "YAxis" are reversed as for an ellipse.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a circle with the transformation theT from class Trsf.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates a circle in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates a circle from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
